Stop waiting for your shower liner to turn yellow and stiff.

Cheap liners break down fast once soap scum and steam get into the plastic. That's why they turn stiff, yellow, or start smelling within a season, no matter how often you clean around them.

This liner is Oeko-tex certified, so it's tested for harmful substances before it ever hangs in your bathroom. It comes in a standard size, and over a hundred thousand people rate it 4.5 stars.
